description: 8 retrieval probes for dart-lang/http — the BSD-3-licensed canonical Dart HTTP client library. NOTE: Dart has NO tree-sitter grammar in GRAMMAR_MAP (core/infrastructure/tree-sitter-provider.js:25) — chunking falls back to the regex chunker registered in core/infrastructure/language-patterns/registry-object-oriented.js. Probes still exercise the indexer + retrieval stack; grammar-edge-case probes target idioms the regex chunker may miss (e.g. `extension X on Y` has no rule).

probes.query: how does the dart http retry client recover from transient failures with exponential backoff
probes.notes: NL behavior probe: RetryClient (line 17, `final class RetryClient extends BaseClient`) re-sends a request on configurable retry conditions with delay-based backoff; `send` (line 113) is the retry loop entry

probes.query: build a multipart form upload with file fields and string fields in dart
probes.notes: NL behavior probe: MultipartRequest (line 33, `class MultipartRequest extends BaseRequest`) is the `multipart/form-data` request builder — pairs `fields` (strings) with `files` (MultipartFile list)

probes.query: abort an in-flight http request in dart using a Future trigger
probes.notes: NL behavior probe: `abstract mixin class Abortable implements BaseRequest` (line 13) provides `abortTrigger` Future — completing the future cancels the request via RequestAbortedException

probes.query: ClientException thrown when an http request fails with uri context
probes.notes: Symbol-anchored probe: ClientException (line 6, `class ClientException implements Exception`) — the base exception type for http failures, carries message + optional Uri

probes.query: MultipartFile fromBytes factory constructor for uploading byte data
probes.notes: Symbol-anchored probe: MultipartFile (line 17) hosts the `factory MultipartFile.fromBytes(...)` (line 60) constructor — wraps a List<int> as a named-field multipart payload

probes.query: Response class with statusCode body headers from an http call
probes.notes: Symbol-anchored probe: Response (line 16, `class Response extends BaseResponse`) — the synchronous fully-buffered response with `body` String, `bodyBytes` Uint8List, and inherited statusCode/headers

probes.query: abstract mixin class BaseClient with default get post put head delete HTTP method implementations
probes.notes: Grammar-edge-case probe: `abstract mixin class BaseClient implements Client` (line 20) — Dart's triple-keyword class modifier (abstract + mixin + class, all distinct) combined with `implements`. Tests whether the regex chunker — `/(?:abstract\s+)?class\s+(\w+)/` — still anchors on `class BaseClient` despite the intervening `mixin` keyword. Expected: regex skips the `abstract mixin` prefix and captures `BaseClient` correctly from the `class` keyword onward.

probes.query: extension HeadersWithSplitValues on BaseResponse for multi-value cookie headers
probes.notes: Grammar-edge-case probe: `extension HeadersWithSplitValues on BaseResponse` (line 150) is a Dart 2.7+ extension method declaration. KNOWN GAP — the dart regex chunker in registry-object-oriented.js (lines 199-204) has chunker rules for class/mixin/function/enum but NO rule for `extension`. Extension methods will fold into the surrounding file chunk rather than emit a named boundary. This probe is an honest grammar-edge-case marker; a PASS here would indicate the embedding model found the right file via header bigrams or surrounding context, not via a chunk-level entity match.
